text:
Lina H: heads up — token-latency dashboards for /chat/generate dropped ~40% of samples around 03:14 UTC, looks correlated with a runtime deploy. per-route qps is fine but the token breakdown shows a gap in 'kernel_select' and 'kv_cache_hit' series.
Mike R: can you paste the anomaly graph? is this StatsD or OTel missing?
Lina H: attaching quick screenshot (uploaded). Baseline: we expect ~100k token latency points/min; we saw ~60k after deploy. StatsD counters for 'tokens.generated' also fell.
Devon S: noticed similar in the ingest pipeline yesterday — exporter buffer config changed in the last infra PR (otel-collector: max_batch_size=2000 -> 200). could be sampling/backpressure.
Harry G: deploy-bot shows a canary of runtime v2.8.4 at 03:10, rolled to stable at 03:12. that release toggled kernel selector heuristic flag "prefer_quantized_kernels" and also bumped statsd client version.
Eva K: quick grep of the runtime logs shows a lot of "exporter queue full" warnings around 03:13:
```
2026-03-16T03:13:22Z WARN exporter_queue full=1 dropped=1234 component=otel_statsd
2026-03-16T03:13:23Z WARN exporter_queue full=1 dropped=980 component=otel_statsd
```
Lina H: ok that explains dropped metrics. but why kernel_select and kv cache points specifically?
Mike R: hypothesis: batching heuristics created larger bursts so exporter saw high cardinality spikes and triggered backpressure, sampler on statsd-client started reducing sample_rate for high-cardinality metrics. Kernel selector emits per-kernel token latencies with kernel_id tag -> high cardinality.
Devon S: can confirm — statsd client change introduced adaptive sampling to avoid hot-path cardinality floods. config snippet in the PR: 
```
statsd:
  adaptive_sampling: true
  sample_threshold: 5000
  min_rate: 0.05
```
Harry G: that explains ~40% drop (adaptive sampler lowered rates for kernel_* series). We should: 1) revert adaptive sampling in the hot path 2) increase otel-collector queue/backpressure thresholds 3) run a targeted backfill for missing token-level points for affected time windows.
Eva K: I'd add: add a low-cardinality rollup metric for per-route token latency (route=/chat/generate, bucket=kernel_type) so we don't rely only on high-cardinality tags. Also add a tracing span annotation when exporter queue_full happens.
Lina H: who can run a small repro/validation? I can patch a canary disabling adaptive_sampling for kernel_* metrics and run it in staging. need an ops ack to tweak otel collector settings short-term.
sre-bot: incident created: #INC-7222 "metrics sampling regression — kernel/kvcache missing token points" assigned to eng-infra.
Mike R: I can coordinate collector tweak. let's set max_queue_size back to 10000 and max_export_batch to 2000 for 30m window, monitor CPU.
Devon S: I'll prepare the backfill job. plan: 1) export raw traces/tokens from runtime shard logs (we still have token traces in local KV for 6h), 2) re-emit StatsD metrics via batching tool with deterministic tags, 3) mark backfill ingestion with label=backfill-march16 so dashboards can exclude duplicates.
Harry G: be careful — backfill must not double-charge billing counters. use the metrics.reemit namespace not tokens.generated.
Eva K: adding an observability TODO: create per-route SLOs for token-instrumentation coverage (target 99.9% of token samples ingested) and an alert when sample rate delta > 10% vs baseline.
Lina H: timeline: Mike applies collector tweak in 10m, I'll push canary patch to disable adaptive_sampling for kernel metrics, Devon will run backfill later today (ETA 6h). If numbers look good after canary, we roll to stable and file a postmortem.
Mike R: ack. posting commands I'll run: 
```bash
# temporary collector tweak (helm):
helm upgrade otel-collector ./otel-chart --set exporters.otlp.max_queue_size=10000 --set processors.batch.max_export_batch_size=2000
```
Lina H: thanks. will follow up with the staging dashboard link. :eyes:
